text:
emma_finance: Luminor Health invoice #10027 (GBP 18,750) autopay failed, card declined. Customer emailed treasury wants to do an international GBP wire, asks if we can accept and if there are FX implications.
payments-bot: [AUTOPAY] invoice=10027 status=failed decline_code=card_declined attempts=2 next_retry=2026-04-05T10:00:00Z
marco_support: Do we have GBP account details? Our main account is USD. We can accept USD wire and let them pay in GBP but that causes FX on our side unless we provide GBP beneficiary.
yasmin_billing: We do have a GBP settlement account but it's internal and requires specific correspondent bank info + intermediary for some banks. Also need exact beneficiary format for UK Faster Payments vs SWIFT.
emma_finance: Customer insists on GBP to avoid their bank conversion fees. Can we provide GBP instructions? Any compliance/KYC note?
fx_treasury: We can accept GBP into our HSBC UK account. Internal rule: for GBP >10k, require payer legal name, VAT/Tax ID (if EU/UK), and invoice reference. Also flag for reconciliation: use reference INV10027-LUMINOR.
marco_support: Can we share this template with customer? Also mention that if they route via a correspondent bank we need the CHAPS/FedRef equivalent trace.
yasmin_billing: Template (for external):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd
Bank: HSBC UK
Sort code: 40-12-34
Account: 12345678
IBAN: GB33BUKB20201555555555
SWIFT/BIC: HBUKGB4B
Reference: INV10027-LUMINOR
Email confirmation: settlements@redwood.com
```
fx_treasury: Add note: "Please include payer VAT/Tax ID in payment narrative if available. If sending via intermediary bank, provide the intermediary details and trace number after payment."
emma_finance: Also confirm we won't mark service suspended while awaiting wire? Customer asked for 24h grace. Approving 24h grace for this case.
marco_support: I'll message customer: "We can accept GBP wire to our HSBC UK account. Please include reference INV10027-LUMINOR and VAT ID in narrative. Send the bank confirmation screenshot once sent; we'll reconcile on receipt. We will hold service for 24h while waiting"
payments-bot: [TICKET] FIN-6120 created for Luminor manual GBP wire and reconciliation.
emma_finance: Quick compliance check: since payer is UK-registered, we still need supplier PO? They attached a PO in email. OK.
marco_support: Customer replies: "Bank says SWIFT will route via intermediary and may add charges. We'll send GBP 18,750 but net may be less after fees. Will that be accepted?"
yasmin_billing: Important: we require the full invoiced amount net of our fees. If their bank deducts correspondent charges, we might receive less. Options: ask payer to cover all charges (OUR), or we accept NET but will generate short-pay adjustment and contact customer. Preference: request OUR but accept NET as last resort.
fx_treasury: Suggested copy to customer: "Please instruct your bank to send funds OUR (pay all charges). If intermediary fees are deducted, please include the remittance screenshot and the intermediary trace so we can chase the shortfall."
emma_finance: Send that. Also include rapid-reconcile steps: once FedRef/trace received, attach to FIN-6120 and tag ops-oncall if reconciliation mismatch.
marco_support: Sent to customer: "Please send OUR. If intermediary fees deducted, include confirmation and we'll work with you. Use reference INV10027-LUMINOR."
marco_support: Customer: "Bank can send OUR but may require a special instruction. They're initiating SWIFT now. Will email confirmation in ~2 hours."
ops-oncall: Note: if funds post in GBP but automated ledger posts in USD equivalent and doesn't auto-match, escalate to ops-oncall with txid. We'll manually allocate.
yasmin_billing: Once funds hit, apply to invoice, mark autopay token blocked, and email receipts + updated payment method instructions for re-enrollment.
payments-bot: [UPDATE] FIN-6120: awaiting confirmation screenshot from customer.
emma_finance: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until funds applied. :white_check_mark:
